// Prints TypeScript's `osq approve` result on a steered change for each row
// of rust-cli "Steered approvals equal TypeScript's" and rust-approve
// "Steered approval refusals".
// Run from the repository root after `pnpm build`:
//   node print-steered-goldens.mjs <fixture approve-repo> <golden folder>
// Each case builds a fresh scratch repository: `<root>/repo` is a copy of the
// fixture on the branch `main`, whose one commit `fixture` holds every file
// but the folder `openspec/changes/001-alpha-twice`, with the git settings
// `user.name` `Osq Tester`, `user.email` `tester@example.com` and
// `commit.gpgsign` `false`. TypeScript reads its settings from
// `osq.config.mjs`, which git ignores through `.git/info/exclude`, as the
// Rust tests ignore `osq.toml`. `node_modules` links to this repository's,
// for TypeScript's pinned OpenSpec validator, and is ignored too.
// With git on, the worktree `<root>/worktrees/repo/001-alpha-twice` is added
// on a new branch `osq/001-alpha-twice` at `main`. The checkout's folder
// `001-alpha-twice` moves to that worktree's `openspec/changes/`, gains
// `.run/approved` holding OLD_SEAL and a newline and the case's markers, and
// is committed there as `osq: 001 approved`. With git off, the folder stays
// in the checkout with the same files. Then `tasks/1.md` gains EDIT, the
// human's plan edit, and is not committed. The case's `extra` runs last.
// The built CLI runs `approve 1` with `repo` as the working directory and
// `<root>/home` as an empty HOME.
// A golden holds the outcome and the approval lines without the digest's
// ` with <flags>` suffix, or the error message with its trailing blank lines
// and any `Next:` hint dropped; then the approval commit, its subject, author
// and changed files, `none` when the branch tip is still `osq: 001 approved`
// or git is off; then the lines of `.git/osq-trees.jsonl` with each `at`
// written `<at>`; then every file under the change folder's `.run/`, sorted
// by path, each event line parsed, its `timestamp` written `<timestamp>` and
// its keys sorted. `.run/manifest.json` and `.run/plan.jsonl` are left out,
// and so is `.run/events/change.jsonl` from the commit's files, since Rust
// writes no manifest or plan record and commits its own `approved` event.
// `<root>` stands for the case's scratch root.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';

const BIN = path.resolve('dist', 'cli', 'bin.js');
const [fixture, golden] = process.argv.slice(2);
const AUTHOR = 'Osq Bot <bot@example.com>';
const DATE = '2026-10-25T10:00:00Z';
const FOLDER = '001-alpha-twice';
const OLD_SEAL = `sha256:${'0'.repeat(64)}`;
const EDIT = '\nSteered once.\n';
const LEFT_OUT = new Set(['.run/manifest.json', '.run/plan.jsonl']);
const COMMIT_LEFT_OUT = new Set([...LEFT_OUT, '.run/events/change.jsonl']);
const KEPT_LINES = ['Approved ', '  Hash: ', '  Worktree: ', '  Branch: ', '  Continues from task '];

const DEAD_VERIFY_RED = ['dead/1.md', '---\nreason: verify_red\n---\nerror: one\n'];
const DEAD_BLOCKED = ['dead/1.md', '---\nreason: blocked\n---\n- needs a port\n'];
const CHANGE_RED = ['regressed/change.md', '---\nreason: verify_red\n---\nchange verify failed\n'];
const DONE_1 = ['done/1', 'done\n'];
const RUNNING_1 = ['running/1.pid', '{"pid":999999,"startedAt":0}\n'];

function lockIndex(repo) {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(repo, '.git', 'worktrees', FOLDER, 'index.lock'), '');
}

const cases = [
  { name: 'dead-001', git: true, markers: [DEAD_VERIFY_RED] },
  { name: 'blocked-001', git: true, markers: [DEAD_BLOCKED] },
  { name: 'change-001', git: true, markers: [DONE_1, CHANGE_RED] },
  { name: 'running-001', git: true, markers: [CHANGE_RED, RUNNING_1] },
  { name: 'commit-fails-001', git: true, markers: [DEAD_BLOCKED], extra: lockIndex },
  { name: 'git-off-001', git: false, markers: [DEAD_BLOCKED] },
];

function git(cwd, args) {
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE: DATE,
    GIT_COMMITTER_DATE: DATE,
    GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: 'Osq Tester',
    GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 'tester@example.com',
    GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: 'Osq Tester',
    GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 'tester@example.com',
  };
  const run = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', env });
  if (run.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: ${run.stderr}`);
  return run.stdout;
}

function configText(root, gitOn) {
  const settings = { enabled: gitOn, author: AUTHOR, worktreeRoot: path.join(root, 'worktrees') };
  return `export default { vcs: ${JSON.stringify(settings)} };\n`;
}

function writeMarkers(folder, markers) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(folder, '.run'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(folder, '.run', 'approved'), `${OLD_SEAL}\n`);
  for (const [relative, text] of markers) {
    const file = path.join(folder, '.run', relative);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(file, text);
  }
}

function buildRepo(root, c) {
  const repo = path.join(root, 'repo');
  fs.cpSync(fixture, repo, { recursive: true });
  git(repo, ['init', '-q', '-b', 'main']);
  git(repo, ['config', 'user.name', 'Osq Tester']);
  git(repo, ['config', 'user.email', 'tester@example.com']);
  git(repo, ['config', 'commit.gpgsign', 'false']);
  fs.appendFileSync(path.join(repo, '.git/info/exclude'), 'osq.config.mjs\nosq.toml\nnode_modules\n');
  fs.symlinkSync(path.resolve('node_modules'), path.join(repo, 'node_modules'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(repo, 'osq.config.mjs'), configText(root, c.git));
  git(repo, ['add', '-A', '--', '.', `:!openspec/changes/${FOLDER}`]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'fixture']);
  const checkout = path.join(repo, 'openspec', 'changes', FOLDER);
  if (!c.git) {
    writeMarkers(checkout, c.markers);
    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'tasks', '1.md'), EDIT);
    return { repo, folder: checkout };
  }
  const worktree = path.join(root, 'worktrees', 'repo', FOLDER);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(worktree), { recursive: true });
  git(repo, ['worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', `osq/${FOLDER}`, worktree, 'main']);
  const folder = path.join(worktree, 'openspec', 'changes', FOLDER);
  fs.cpSync(checkout, folder, { recursive: true });
  fs.rmSync(checkout, { recursive: true, force: true });
  writeMarkers(folder, c.markers);
  git(worktree, ['add', '-A']);
  git(worktree, ['commit', '-q', '-m', 'osq: 001 approved']);
  fs.appendFileSync(path.join(folder, 'tasks', '1.md'), EDIT);
  return { repo, folder };
}

function files(base, dir, out) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    const relative = path.relative(base, full).split(path.sep).join('/');
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files(base, full, out);
    else out.push(relative);
  }
  return out;
}

function sorted(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sorted);
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(value)
        .sort()
        .map((key) => [key, sorted(value[key])]),
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function eventLine(line) {
  const parsed = JSON.parse(line);
  if ('timestamp' in parsed) parsed.timestamp = '<timestamp>';
  return JSON.stringify(sorted(parsed));
}

function runTree(folder) {
  const lines = [];
  for (const relative of files(folder, path.join(folder, '.run'), []).sort()) {
    if (LEFT_OUT.has(relative)) continue;
    const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(folder, relative), 'utf8');
    lines.push(`--- ${relative}`);
    if (relative.endsWith('.jsonl')) {
      for (const line of text.split('\n')) if (line !== '') lines.push(eventLine(line));
    } else {
      lines.push(text.endsWith('\n') ? text.slice(0, -1) : text);
    }
  }
  return lines;
}

function commitLines(repo, c) {
  if (!c.git) return ['none'];
  const branch = `osq/${FOLDER}`;
  const [subject, author] = git(repo, ['log', '-1', '--format=%s%n%an <%ae>', branch])
    .trim()
    .split('\n');
  if (subject === 'osq: 001 approved' && author === 'Osq Tester <tester@example.com>') {
    return ['none'];
  }
  const changed = git(repo, ['diff-tree', '--no-commit-id', '--name-status', '-r', branch])
    .trim()
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => !COMMIT_LEFT_OUT.has(line.split('\t')[1].replace(/^.*\/(\.run\/)/, '$1')))
    .sort();
  return [subject, author, ...changed];
}

function treeRecord(repo) {
  const file = path.join(repo, '.git', 'osq-trees.jsonl');
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
  return fs
    .readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line !== '')
    .map((line) => JSON.stringify({ ...JSON.parse(line), at: '<at>' }));
}

function outcome(run, c) {
  if (run.status === 0) {
    const kept = run.stdout
      .split('\n')
      .filter((line) => KEPT_LINES.some((p) => line.startsWith(p)))
      .map((line) => line.replace(/^(Approved \S+ \(\S+\)) with .*$/, '$1'));
    return `outcome: output\n${kept.join('\n')}`;
  }
  const prefix = 'Error approving 1:\n  ';
  if (!run.stderr.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error(`${c.name}: unexpected stderr ${run.stderr}`);
  let message = run.stderr.slice(prefix.length);
  const next = message.indexOf('\nNext: ');
  if (next >= 0) message = message.slice(0, next + 1);
  return `outcome: failed\n${message.replace(/\s+$/, '')}`;
}

for (const c of cases) {
  const root = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'osq-approve-steered-')));
  const home = path.join(root, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  const { repo, folder } = buildRepo(root, c);
  c.extra?.(repo);
  const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, [BIN, 'approve', '1'], {
    cwd: repo,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    env: { ...process.env, HOME: home, NO_COLOR: '1', OSQ_SERVER: '' },
  });
  const text = [
    outcome(run, c),
    'commit:',
    ...commitLines(repo, c),
    'record:',
    ...treeRecord(repo),
    'tree:',
    ...runTree(folder),
  ].join('\n');
  const placed = text.split(root).join('<root>');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(golden, `${c.name}.txt`), `${placed.replace(/\n+$/, '')}\n`);
  fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
